data.raw_text:
🙏🇺🇸🙏

Gaylord Anderson ran straight into machine gun fire when others were pinned down and had nowhere to move. It was March 15, 1945, on the Bataan Peninsula in the Philippines. The jungle was alive with gunfire. Enemy positions tearing through American lines. Men were trapped.
Wounded. Calling for help. Anderson did not hesitate. He had already been wounded before in New Guinea, a bullet tearing through his leg, but he was back in the fight. He saw his fellow soldiers down and moved forward through smoke and bullets, reaching them one by one. He grabbed them. Dragged them. Pulled them out of open fire while returning sh*ts toward the enemy.
No cover. No safety. Just movement and risk with every second. He got two men out. Alive. Then he went back again. Still under fire. Still pushing forward. In the middle of that rescue, a sniper's round hit him. He fell where he stood. He was 27.
Old enough to fight. Old enough to sacrifice. Too young to d*e. The men he pulled to safety lived because he did not stop. Back home, his mother received the news that ended everything. Three months later, she followed him, her heart broken beyond repair. The war is remembered. The battle is remembered. But most people will never know the soldier who ran into gunfire to save others and never made it back 🙏🇺🇸🙏

data.raw_text:
A Heartwarming Call to Everyone:

After several days of planning and discussion, this initiative with nothing but love and purpose in our hearts, Team Heath Official is finally reaching out to everyone, because today, more than ever, our road heroes need us.

Every morning, as we step into a jeepney, ride a tricycle, or watch a motorcycle speed through traffic, we witness the silent warriors who keep our daily lives moving.

But recently… we’ve also witnessed their struggle.
With the surge of gasoline prices in the Philippines, the weight they carry has become heavier, much heavier than what most of us will ever know.

Look closely the next time you ride:
There is someone driving a jeepney who has been awake since dawn just to earn enough for the day…
Someone filling a motorcycle tank and counting every peso…
Someone pedaling a tricycle under the scorching heat just to bring a little money home.
Behind every trip is a story.
Behind every fare is a sacrifice.
Behind every driver is a family praying that today won’t be too hard.

And today… we are asking, from the deepest part of our hearts:
Please help us help them. ❤️
Not with big donations.
Not with expectations.
But with any amount your heart is willing to give.

This initiative carefully planned, prayed for, and made with love is our way of holding the hands of the people who never fail to serve us, even when the world feels unfair.

Let us stand together for our jeepney drivers.
For our motorcycle riders.
For our tricycle drivers.
For the ones who carry us safely through our days.
Let us help our road heroes.

Even a small amount can become fuel,
fuel for their tanks,
fuel for their hope,
fuel to remind them that this world still cares.

Together, let’s give them the love they so freely give us every single day. 

Heath would be so happy knowing that we can also share our love to them.

ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA🚦

Pansamantalang isasara ang Katipunan Kaliwa St. / Lokaria St. sa Brgy. Bagbag mula Mindanao Avenue hanggang King Alexander St. simula bukas, March 30 ng 10:00 PM hanggang April 6, 2026 ng 4:00 AM. Ito’y upang bigyang-daan ang konstruksyon ng underpass kaugnay ng NLEX–C5 Northlink Segment 8.2 Section 1A project.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta at planuhin ang biyahe nang mas maaga.

Magtatalaga rin ng traffic enforcers upang tumulong sa pamamahala ng daloy ng trapiko, at maglalagay ng directional signs para gabayan ang mga motorista.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.
